item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 16/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
The band of clouds now covering the coast of Guangdong will thin out today and tomorrow, it will be brighter over the region. A strong northeast monsoon will reach the coast of southern China later on Sunday. Temperatures over Guangdong will fall progressively in the following few days. Tropical Cyclone Man-yi over the western North Pacific will move towards Luzon today and tomorrow, then enter the central and northern parts of the South China Sea and move in the general direction of the vicinity of Hainan Island. Under its combined effect with the northeast monsoon, it will be windy with a few rain patches over the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea midweek next week. Besides, Tropical Cyclone Usagi will turn northeastwards gradually across southern Taiwan and continue to weaken today and tomorrow.
